notes:
Account summary: BrightCart is a mid-market e-commerce platform focused on post-purchase experience — returns, shipping status, and agent-assisted chat. Team is product-led; engineering-heavy. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API initially to accelerate time-to-value; goal is to graduate to Dedicated for predictable latency and isolation before peak season.

Key contacts: Jordan Lee (AE), Maya Patel (SE), Lina Torres (Head of Product at BrightCart), Samir Rao (Eng lead).

Business drivers: reduce average handle time for returns, provide agent-assist suggestions (snippets, recommended workflows), and surface SLA-safe shipping updates to customers via chat. Peak traffic seasonality: 3x traffic Nov-Dec and smaller spikes around major promos. They need a p95 latency SLO for agent completions <= 250ms token time (streaming enabled) and end-to-end p95 for tool-calls (order lookups / refunds) <= 600ms.

Technical requirements & preferences:
- Workload: high-concurrency chat sessions with tool calling (order lookup, refund initiation, label print).
- Latency targets: p95 < 250ms per-token/streaming step; tool-call end-to-end p95 < 600ms.
- Throughput: baseline 250 reqs/min with burst up to 1200 reqs/min during promos.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; willing to commit if Dedicated demonstrably lowers unit cost and meets latency SLOs.
- Model preferences: open models for retrieval-augmented generation; prefer quantized variants if quality pass.
- Routing/fallback: need automated fallback from higher-capacity model -> lower-cost variant without user-visible regressions.
- Security: SOC2, SSO (SAML), audit logging, KMS for keys, and EU data residency for subset of EU customers.

POC plan (agreed):
- Phase 1 (2 weeks): Hosted API quickstart, integrate streaming + tool-calls in staging, run synthetic load tests for p95 targets. Drive doc: Redwood_POC_Specs_v1.pdf.
- Phase 2 (1 week): Pricing + feasibility review; evaluate Dedicated options (reserved GPU pools) for Nov/Dec scaling.
- Phase 3 (1 week): Week-long Dedicated trial focused on peak-scaling simulation (private quota/burst).
